resources.string: Real data, always: a live fetch is attempted first. If no network is available, this automatically falls back to any offline data you\'ve pre-downloaded for this country (see Offline Country Data below). If neither is available, you\'ll see a clear error — never fabricated results.
Requires your own free OpenTopography API key (opentopography.org). Saved securely on this device (encrypted) so you only enter it once — never sent anywhere except OpenTopography\'s own API.

Real NDVI (Copernicus), always: a live per-candidate check is attempted first; if that\'s unavailable for every candidate, this falls back to your offline Sentinel-2 composite for this country, if downloaded.

Requires your own free Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem OAuth client ID/secret (dataspace.copernicus.eu). Saved securely on this device (encrypted) so you only enter it once. For each DEM candidate, fetches real NDVI mean/stdDev for a small core area at the point and a larger halo area around it; a core significantly below the halo indicates vegetation stress, a real documented signature of buried features.

Download DEM + NDVI data for an entire country so investigations can run with no network access. This can take a long time (potentially hours) and use a large amount of mobile data — a Wi-Fi connection is strongly recommended.

Downloads DEM tiles from the public Copernicus DEM bucket and Sentinel-2 NDVI composites from the public Earth Search STAC API — both free, no account needed. Already-downloaded tiles/cells are skipped automatically, so this can safely be stopped and resumed later.

Downloaded country data is saved to your phone\'s real shared storage (not this app\'s private storage), so it survives an uninstall or a move to a new phone — no cloud backup needed. This requires a one-time permission: tap below, then enable the toggle on the settings screen that opens.
